stages.whoA: Her boss, the founder of the company
stages.whoB: An employee at his tech company

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Turgeon supervises Simmons in the HYDRA lab and lets her coach him for a report to his superiors. Weeks later they share a project, and he is blamed as the mole she really is.
stages.whoA: The undercover agent he supervises
stages.whoB: Her supervisor in the HYDRA lab

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bakshi sends Turgeon and Simmons to Whitehall's meeting. When evidence turns up at Turgeon's desk, Bakshi's men knock him out and drag him away.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA officer who drags him off
stages.whoB: A lab supervisor accused of spying

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi, working HYDRA security, announces a mole in the lab, and the search finds evidence at Turgeon's desk. He tells her it is not his before he is dragged away.
stages.whoA: A HYDRA security chief who accuses him
stages.whoB: A lab supervisor caught in her search

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: In the Framework, May comes to Turgeon's HYDRA lab for his new serum. He explains what is in it and promises one dose will leave the Patriot begging for his life.
stages.whoA: A HYDRA agent who takes his serum
stages.whoB: A HYDRA scientist with a serum

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Garrett teleports Malick's crew, this soldier among them, onto the stolen Zephyr, and they fly into space together to meet the Chronicom fleet.
stages.whoA: A teleporting member of Malick's crew
stages.whoB: A soldier in Malick's crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Kimball watches as Kora reaches Daisy on the Chronicom ship and ruins Malick's plan. When the fight spreads through the fleet, Daisy quakes it apart, killing Kimball.
stages.whoA: The agent who destroys the fleet
stages.whoB: A soldier in Malick's crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Zeller runs the soldier handlers at Cybertek for Garrett and reports when May brings the Barbershop down. Skye then uses Zeller's phone to warn Garrett that Coulson is coming.
stages.whoA: His HYDRA boss
stages.whoB: His handler at Cybertek

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Skye storms the handlers' room with a bomb, straps it to Zeller and guesses he is a pawn of the Incentives Program. She drags him to the dormitories, frees his wife, and shows him the bomb is a toy.
stages.whoA: The agent who frees his wife
stages.whoB: A coerced handler she bluffs

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: May and Skye bluff their way into the handlers' room at Cybertek. May holds off Ward while Skye takes Zeller to free his wife.
stages.whoA: An agent who storms his control room
stages.whoB: A Cybertek handler she helps capture

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Li serves as Jiaying's second-in-command, pressing her to kill Kora and warning that May and Yo-Yo cannot be allowed to leave Afterlife. When Malick attacks, Jiaying escapes while Li is captured.
stages.whoA: The Afterlife leader he serves
stages.whoB: Her second-in-command at Afterlife

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Li distrusts May at Afterlife, tells her he decides when she leaves and attacks her with a knife he creates. Later both fight off Malick's men when they attack Afterlife.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he attacks
stages.whoB: Jiaying's suspicious second-in-command

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Li doubts Yo-Yo's story and makes her touch a Diviner to prove she is Inhuman. He attacks May hoping to force Yo-Yo to use her powers, but she cannot.
stages.whoA: An agent he tests with a Diviner
stages.whoB: The Inhuman who tests her with a Diviner

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Li and Gordon chase Kora through the woods and find May and Yo-Yo, and Li orders Gordon to teleport them to Afterlife.
stages.whoA: A fellow Afterlife Inhuman
stages.whoB: Jiaying's second-in-command

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Mack sees his mother held in the Lighthouse and calls off the mission to rescue her. On the Quinjet he finds she is a Chronicom wearing her face, and despite her calling him Alfie he throws her out.
stages.whoA: Mack, the son she pretends to be mother to
stages.whoB: A Chronicom wearing his mother's face

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Yo-Yo helps Mack free his parents and chats with Lilla on the Quinjet. Once the Chronicoms are exposed, Lilla beats Yo-Yo in the fight.
stages.whoA: Mack's girlfriend, who helps rescue her
stages.whoB: The Chronicom posing as Mack's mother

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: May flies the Quinjet out of the Lighthouse with Mack's parents aboard. When they turn out to be Chronicoms, Lilla nearly overpowers May until Mack steps in.
stages.whoA: The agent she fights on the Quinjet
stages.whoB: A Chronicom who fights her on the Quinjet

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Lindsay works for Deke at his tech company and fetches his charcoal water. When Deke shows off his staff hidden in the Lighthouse, she brings him a rose gold gadget and cheers his teleport.
stages.whoA: Her boss, founder of the company
stages.whoB: One of his staff at the company

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Russo's men take May after she leaves the train, and he stabs her while offering her Cybertek's money. She breaks free and later kills him with a thrown knife before he can shoot Coulson.
stages.whoA: The agent who kills him
stages.whoB: Italian contact who tortures her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson asks Russo to help get his team onto the Cybertek train. Russo sells them out, then comes to the Bus hiding a gun until May stops him.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who trusts him
stages.whoB: Italian contact who betrays him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lucio is Colonel Ramon's Inhuman enforcer in the Colombian police. Together they ambush Bobbi and Hunter, and Lucio keeps them frozen while Ramon questions them.
stages.whoA: His commander in the Colombian police
stages.whoB: His Inhuman enforcer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lucio freezes Bobbi and Hunter so Ramon can take them. Under questioning at the station, Bobbi mocks him as Medusa eyes.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he paralyzes
stages.whoB: Colombian cop whose stare paralyzes

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Yo-Yo storms the police station to free Bobbi and Hunter and snaps a cuff on Lucio. He freezes her first, and she slams into a wall.
stages.whoA: Inhuman who cuffs him in the raid
stages.whoB: Police Inhuman who freezes her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: In the raid on the station, Joey melts Lucio's sunglasses onto his face. Later Lucio ambushes the Secret Warriors for HYDRA, and Joey kills him.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman who kills him
stages.whoB: HYDRA's Inhuman, whom he kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lucio tries to freeze Hive when HYDRA brings him in, but Hive breaks through and takes him over. Lucio then freezes five humans for Hive to feed on.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman who enthralls him
stages.whoB: An Inhuman in his thrall

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera brings the captured Lucio to Hive. Once Hive takes Lucio over, the two of them gather five healthy humans for Hive.
stages.whoA: Malick's Inhuman, who brings him to Hive
stages.whoB: An Inhuman who serves Hive with him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks leads Price's ATCU teams hunting Inhumans and reports every escape to her. After she is killed, he joins S.H.I.E.L.D. to go after the man who took her.
stages.whoA: His boss, head of the ATCU
stages.whoB: Her right-hand man

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Mack and Banks hunt Lincoln together and end in a standoff until their bosses make a deal. Mack later tails Banks as a Lash suspect, then welcomes him at the Playground after Price dies.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who tails, then trusts him
stages.whoB: Price's ATCU man

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks threatens Daisy with snipers when Lincoln slips away, then works beside her on the Lash case. Daisy suspects he is Lash and tails him, but his blood test clears him.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. Inhuman who suspects him
stages.whoB: ATCU agent she suspects of being Lash

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hunter knocks Banks out on the street so Simmons can test his blood. At Endotex, Banks chases the undercover Hunter, then leads him and Bobbi out once Price learns HYDRA is inside the ATCU.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent he leads to safety
stages.whoB: ATCU agent who gets him out of Endotex

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks and Giyera both work at Endotex, where Giyera serves HYDRA in secret. At the Distant Star facility, Giyera seizes Banks's gun, makes him shoot the S.H.I.E.L.D. team, and kills him with it.
stages.whoA: HYDRA's Inhuman, who kills him
stages.whoB: ATCU agent he kills with his own gun

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks comes to the Playground to avenge Price and tells Fitz and Simmons about Project Distant Star. He takes them into the facility, where Giyera kills him in front of them.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist he guides
stages.whoB: ATCU agent killed in front of him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Banks holds Coulson at gunpoint when he corners Price on a train, until Coulson disarms him with his prosthetic hand. Once Price and Coulson join forces, Banks works beside his team on the Lash case.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. Director who disarms him, then works with him
stages.whoB: Price's ATCU man

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Malachi hunts Fitz across space and snatches him from the House of Games. He guards Fitz for Atarah, strikes him with his rifle, then uses the memories taken from Fitz to plan his attack on the Lighthouse.
stages.whoA: The man he hunts
stages.whoB: Chronicom Hunter who hunts him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Malachi nearly shoots Simmons on the Zephyr before Davis knocks him out. He watches the Chronicoms draw out her memories and uses them against S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: Agent whose memories he uses
stages.whoB: Chronicom Hunter who hunts her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Malachi sneers that Enoch has grown too emotional and holds him at gunpoint during the memory draw. Enoch shuts down the Hunters with an override, then poses as one of Malachi's men in the Lighthouse.
stages.whoA: Chronicom he scorns as too emotional
stages.whoB: Chronicom Hunter who scorns him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Davis knocks out Malachi when he ambushes the Zephyr and keeps him cuffed. Malachi slips free while Davis is sick, knocks him out, and escapes.
stages.whoA: Zephyr crewman who captures him
stages.whoB: Chronicom prisoner who escapes him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Malachi shoots down Daisy when he storms the Zephyr. Questioned by her and Simmons, he says Fitz is wanted for tampering with the universe.
stages.whoA: Agent who questions him
stages.whoB: Chronicom Hunter chasing Fitz

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Malachi's Hunters still hold the Lighthouse when S.H.I.E.L.D. storms back in. After May and Kora's empathy reaches them, Yo-Yo asks if they are friends or enemies, and Malachi drops his rifle and says friends.
stages.whoA: Agent he greets as a friend
stages.whoB: Chronicom Hunter who turns friendly

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Scarlotti's fake S.H.I.E.L.D. squad storms Talbot's UN meeting, and his splinter bomb breaks Talbot's arm. After May beats him, he is taken away under Talbot's watch.
stages.whoA: General whose UN meeting he attacks
stages.whoB: Mercenary who attacks the UN

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: May bursts into the safe house where Scarlotti lies in wait for S.H.I.E.L.D. agents. He knocks the gun from her hand with his rope dart, but she takes his blade and knocks him down.
stages.whoA: The agent who beats him
stages.whoB: HYDRA's hired killer, whom she beats

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Hunter walks into the safe house claiming to be a fellow merc and stalls Scarlotti for May and Bobbi. Scarlotti kicks him down when the agents burst in.
stages.whoA: Merc who bluffs his way in
stages.whoB: HYDRA's hired killer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi names Scarlotti as the UN attacker, an assassin who once nearly killed Barton. She crashes into the safe house with May and fights his men.
stages.whoA: Agent who identifies him
stages.whoB: Assassin she identifies

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Marta's men hold Fitz and Ward in a bar while she decides their fate. Fitz shorts her power, then fixes it, wins her over, and pays her to get them across the border.
stages.whoA: Captive engineer who wins her over
stages.whoB: Ossetian boss who smuggles them

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Captured with Fitz, Ward waits on Marta's verdict in her bar. Once Fitz wins her favor, she gets them both across the border.
stages.whoA: Captive agent she helps
stages.whoB: Ossetian boss who smuggles them

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mertz shows Elena and her friends a trick at a Miami party. When the Watchdogs try to shoot him as the Inhuman, she grabs their guns and gives herself away to save him.
stages.whoA: Party guest who saves his life
stages.whoB: A party magician she saves

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Skye warns her boyfriend Miles that S.H.I.E.L.D. is coming and joins him in Austin. When she learns he sold data for a million dollars, she breaks it off and says goodbye in Hong Kong.
stages.whoA: Skye, his hacker girlfriend
stages.whoB: Her hacker ex-boyfriend

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson has Miles brought in for the hack that got Chan kidnapped. After Miles helps vent Chan's blast, Coulson puts a tracking bracelet on him and leaves him in Hong Kong.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who punishes him
stages.whoB: A hacker he leaves in Hong Kong

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Kitson blames Fitz for cheating with a synthetic and bringing bounty hunters to his house. He puts Fitz on the blade game, then sells him to Izel.
stages.whoA: Terran cheat he sentences to the blades
stages.whoB: Ruler of the House of Games

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Simmons appeals to Kitson's pride in his home, but he sentences her to the blade game. When Izel threatens him, he rigs the game so the other player dies and sells the Terrans to Izel.
stages.whoA: Terran he sentences to the blades
stages.whoB: Ruler of the House of Games

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Kitson has Enoch brought in as the synthetic who cheated at his tables. He calls killing a synthetic a wasted sport and sends Enoch to his brothels instead.
stages.whoA: Synthetic he sends to the brothels
stages.whoB: Ruler who sentences him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Faulnak puts Maston-Dar over Sinara in the hunt, and the two use Flint as bait. As Maston-Dar blasts through the wall to the fugitives, Sinara shoots him from behind.
stages.whoA: Kasius's warrior, who kills him
stages.whoB: Faulnak's warrior, whom she kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Maston-Dar corners the fugitives in the gravity room and shoots Fitz in the stomach. Daisy gets Fitz away while the room fills with smoke.
stages.whoA: A fugitive he shoots
stages.whoB: Kree hunter who shoots him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Maston-Dar stands behind Faulnak as Daisy fights Sinara in the Crater. Sent to bring her in, he hunts her through the Lighthouse, and she disarms him in the smoke.
stages.whoA: The Destroyer he is sent to capture
stages.whoB: Faulnak's hunter

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Coulson ambushes Maston-Dar and Sinara to free Flint. Maston-Dar knocks him down, but Coulson's prosthetic punches and Mack's pipe hold him off.
stages.whoA: Agent who outfights him
stages.whoB: Kree warrior he fights

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Ellis rebrands Rhodey's armor as the Iron Patriot and sends him after the Mandarin. When Savin uses the stolen suit to kidnap Ellis, Rhodey frees him on the Norco.
stages.whoA: The colonel he makes the Iron Patriot
stages.whoB: The President he serves

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Killian has Ellis flown to the Norco in the Iron Patriot suit and plans to burn him on live TV so the Vice President takes power. Tony and Rhodey stop him.
stages.whoA: The man who plans to kill him on TV
stages.whoB: The President he means to execute

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Savin, wearing the stolen Iron Patriot armor, kills Ellis's guards on Air Force One. He seals the President inside the suit and sends him to Killian.
stages.whoA: Extremis soldier who kidnaps him
stages.whoB: The President he abducts

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Ellis meets Coulson where Rosalind died and agrees to back S.H.I.E.L.D. in secret, though he will not move on Malick. He names Talbot to run the ATCU and joins Coulson in Moscow to calm the Russians.
stages.whoA: The Director he backs in secret
stages.whoB: The President, his secret backer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Nathanson blocks Coulson and Mack at the lab door until Simmons tells him to leave them be. When May falls ill, Simmons calls him over to help.
stages.whoA: Scientist who gives him orders
stages.whoB: A lab agent she orders around

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Director Mace sends Nathanson with Aida to Radcliffe's lab to collect the LMD research. It is the last job Nathanson is given.
stages.whoA: The Director who sends him to Radcliffe's
stages.whoB: An agent he sends to Radcliffe's lab

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Nathanson escorts Aida back to Radcliffe's lab. When he finds May bleeding in a hidden room, Aida says she is sorry and snaps his neck.
stages.whoA: The android who kills him
stages.whoB: Agent she kills to hide May

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Coulson questions the Area 51 scientists to find the Chronicom among them. When the scientist slams Daisy into a wall, Coulson fights him and is winning until Sousa steps in.
stages.whoA: LMD agent who fights him
stages.whoB: Chronicom posing as a scientist

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Sousa's arrest of the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents saves the disguised Chronicom from being found out. Later Sousa strikes him with his cane, and the Chronicom chokes him until an EMP shuts him down.
stages.whoA: Agent who hits him with a cane
stages.whoB: Chronicom who chokes him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Daisy tries to lead the scientist away from Helius, and he throws her into a wall. She and Simmons then stop him with an EMP.
stages.whoA: Agent who stops him with an EMP
stages.whoB: Chronicom posing as a scientist

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: O'Brien works the Bahrain op where May backs up Coulson. Under Katya's control he fights May, who frees him by killing the girl.
stages.whoA: The agent who frees him in Bahrain
stages.whoB: An agent she frees in Bahrain

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: O'Brien volunteers for May's strike team against Hive in Union City. Their shots do nothing to Hive, and May orders a retreat.
stages.whoA: Leader of his strike team
stages.whoB: An agent on her strike team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: In Bahrain, O'Brien watches the bar while Coulson talks to Eva Belyakov. When Coulson calls after the team is taken, the entranced O'Brien tells him to leave them alone.
stages.whoA: Agent on the Bahrain op
stages.whoB: An agent on the Bahrain op

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Coulson briefs O'Brien's team on Zephyr One before Union City. He orders them out when the Kree beacon activates, then tells them to attack Hive.
stages.whoA: Director who briefs his team
stages.whoB: An agent on the Hive strike

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Katya takes over O'Brien and the agents who go in after her. May shoots her, which frees O'Brien, who wakes up remembering nothing.
stages.whoA: Girl who takes over his mind
stages.whoB: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent in her thrall

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: O'Brien tails Fitz to a cafe after Fitz says he wants out of S.H.I.E.L.D. He bangs on the bathroom door while Fitz secretly works on the Toolbox.
stages.whoA: Engineer he tails
stages.whoB: Agent who tails him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Fitz and O'Brien check crates at the Playground before moving Hive. Fitz spots the bomb too late, and the Terrigen gas turns O'Brien into a Primitive.
stages.whoA: Engineer he works with
stages.whoB: Agent turned into a Primitive

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: O'Brien and Piper volunteer for May's strike team against Hive, and Piper beats him to a weapon from the Cupboard. They fire on Hive together in the church and run when he heals.
stages.whoA: Fellow agent on the Hive strike
stages.whoB: Fellow agent on the Hive strike

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: O'Brien fires on Hive in a Union City church with no effect. Back at the Playground, a Terrigen bomb makes him one of Hive's Primitives.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman he fights, then serves
stages.whoB: Agent who becomes his Primitive

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bakshi calls Bloom after a mercenary frees him and comes to his winery, claiming a kill order was put out on him. Bloom believes him and orders the other HYDRA heads killed.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA man who comes to him for protection
stages.whoB: The HYDRA head who takes him in

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: List sits at Bloom's table when the HYDRA heads meet to replace Whitehall. Later Bloom calls him, and List swears that he and Strucker gave no order to kill Bakshi.
stages.whoA: A fellow HYDRA leader
stages.whoB: The HYDRA head who hosts the meeting

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Hunter poses as the mercenary who freed Bakshi and drives him to Bloom's estate. When Bloom's men fail to kill him, Hunter bursts in with Bobbi and shoots Bloom dead.
stages.whoA: The fake mercenary who kills him
stages.whoB: The HYDRA head he shoots

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi waits near Bloom's estate while Hunter delivers Bakshi. She storms Bloom's house with Hunter after the other HYDRA heads are killed.
stages.whoA: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who raids his home
stages.whoB: A HYDRA head she helps take down

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Deke recruited Olga into his band and secret squad and shows her off to Mack. She turns his Gauntlet into a real blast, then plants the bomb that Deke sets off to destroy a robot.
stages.whoA: Her bandleader and squad leader
stages.whoB: His band's demolitions expert

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Mack scolds the squad after Olga's Gauntlet goes wrong, then saves her from one of Sibyl's robots. Wounded, she accepts him as her leader and follows his plan to blow up the next robot.
stages.whoA: The Director she comes to follow
stages.whoB: A squad member he leads against the robots

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Oliver sits on the council Gonzales leads aboard the Iliad. He votes with the council on the Arctic raid and sides with Gonzales that he, not Coulson, should meet the Inhumans.
stages.whoA: The leader of his S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: A senior agent on his council

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Weaver and Oliver serve together on Gonzales's council and both argue for treating the Inhumans as a threat. When Jiaying seizes the Iliad, Weaver watches Oliver die in the Terrigen Mist.
stages.whoA: A fellow council member
stages.whoB: A fellow council member

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Oliver's council takes Coulson's base and later becomes his advisers when the two S.H.I.E.L.D.s merge. After Gonzales dies, Oliver pushes for an attack on the Inhumans that Coulson refuses.
stages.whoA: The Director he advises and argues with
stages.whoB: An adviser who wants war with the Inhumans

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: On the Iliad, Oliver asks Mack to stay when Mack plans to quit and ride with his brother. Their talk is cut short by news that Gonzales has been killed.
stages.whoA: An agent he tries to keep on
stages.whoB: A council member who asks him to stay

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Jiaying's Inhumans take the Iliad and hold Oliver hostage. When he refuses to help her, she locks him in a room with a Terrigen crystal and he turns to stone.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman leader who kills him
stages.whoB: A hostage who refuses her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Coulson, posing as Gerald Sharpe, gets a tour of Vega's lab and jokes about the Helius model. When the Chronicoms power up Helius, he sends Vega to evacuate the base.
stages.whoA: The visiting 'Mr. Sharpe'
stages.whoB: The Area 51 scientist who gives him a tour

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Simmons, posing as Peggy Carter, tours Vega's lab and questions his staff. She later rushes to the prototype EMP he showed her to stop Helius.
stages.whoA: The visiting 'Agent Carter'
stages.whoB: The scientist whose EMP she uses

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Yo-Yo questions Pax and Jaco in custody, and Pax lets slip Sarge's bomb. When he tries to seize Zephyr One, she beats him, gags him and pushes him into the Shelter Charge field.
stages.whoA: The speedster who keeps catching him
stages.whoB: A prisoner who talks too much

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Mack knocks Pax out when he attacks Deke and holds him prisoner on Zephyr One. Pax warns Mack that flying toward Sarge is a mistake.
stages.whoA: The Director who captures him
stages.whoB: One of Sarge's men he captures

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: May finds Pax in Sarge's truck during the jewel store robbery and knocks him out. He later throws smoke and fires on her team when they come to rescue Deke.
stages.whoA: The agent who beats him in the truck
stages.whoB: One of Sarge's mercenaries

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Pax hunts Deke through his company, kills a man by mistake and slashes Deke with a knife. Mack knocks Pax down and Deke shoots him with an ICER until it runs out.
stages.whoA: A target he hunts for Sarge
stages.whoB: One of the mercenaries who attack him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Polly brings her young daughter to the park to meet Daisy, who gives the girl a robin her father carved.
stages.whoA: Her young daughter
stages.whoB: Her mother

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Polly cares for Robin after her Terrigenesis, though Robin barely speaks to her and calls May 'mom'. Talbot takes Robin, and Polly tells her not to help him before the Remorath drag Polly away.
stages.whoA: Her daughter, a seer
stages.whoB: Her mother

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Daisy calls Polly after touching Charles and seeing a death, and Polly tells her what his visions did to him. Later Polly thanks Daisy for the money that let her family move.
stages.whoA: The friend who helps her family
stages.whoB: Charles Hinton's wife

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Daisy apologizes for pulling Polly and Robin out of hiding to find Coulson. After Talbot attacks, Daisy takes them to shelter with Tony Caine.
stages.whoA: The agent who keeps her family safe
stages.whoB: Robin's mother

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Fitz finds Polly and Robin in the park to learn why he was left behind. After the escape, he gets them home safe before freezing himself to reach the future.
stages.whoA: The agent she helps reach Robin
stages.whoB: Robin's mother

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Talbot paces Robin's room at the Lighthouse, then chokes Polly and takes her daughter. Later he holds them both and uses Polly to pressure Robin about the Gravitonium.
stages.whoA: The general who chokes her and takes Robin
stages.whoB: Robin's mother

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: May wins Robin's trust and helps her draw where Coulson is, and Polly admits she is in none of Robin's drawings. May later helps free Polly from the Remorath ship.
stages.whoA: The agent her daughter calls mom
stages.whoB: Robin's mother

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: May trains Prince and the rest of her strike team at the Playground. He goes on her team's missions, including taking Coulson and Mack out of the field.
stages.whoA: The commander of his strike team
stages.whoB: An agent on her strike team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Prince and Piper train together on May's strike team. When the LMDs take the Playground, they gather the unconscious agents onto Zephyr One, and later pull Fitz away from Aida.
stages.whoA: A teammate on May's strike team
stages.whoB: A teammate on May's strike team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Prince and Davis go into the prison together and later guard Shockley. On Zephyr One, Prince needles Davis while he flies them out of danger.
stages.whoA: The pilot he rides with
stages.whoB: A teammate who heckles his flying

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Daisy leads Prince into the prison to find Coulson and May and later pushes him clear of Shockley. Prince watches over her body on Zephyr One while she is in the Framework.
stages.whoA: The agent he follows on missions
stages.whoB: An agent from May's strike team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Aida turns on the team at the ruined Playground. As Prince tries to protect Fitz, she appears behind him and snaps his neck.
stages.whoA: The android who kills him
stages.whoB: An agent she kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Qovas offers Hale the Confederacy's protection for Earth in exchange for Gravitonium and Inhumans, and gives her a vial of Odium. When she comes uninvited after Ruby's death, he takes her word on where the Gravitonium is.
stages.whoA: The HYDRA general he makes his deal with
stages.whoB: The alien who offers her a deal

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Talbot boards Qovas's ship with Coulson and crushes one of his soldiers until Qovas kneels. Qovas then calls the Confederacy together for Talbot and holds his prisoners for him.
stages.whoA: The Graviton who makes him kneel
stages.whoB: An alien commander who kneels to him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Qovas locks May and Coulson in a cell on his ship. When she escapes, they fight with Remorath claws, and he fires his missiles, not knowing they now target his own ship.
stages.whoA: The agent who beats him on his ship
stages.whoB: The alien commander she duels

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Hale brings Coulson to Qovas, who shows him a vision of the coming attack. Later Coulson refuses Qovas the Gravitonium, and Qovas holds him prisoner on his ship.
stages.whoA: The Director who refuses him
stages.whoB: The alien who besieges the Lighthouse

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Deke slips aboard Qovas's ship and frees Coulson and May. While Qovas fights May, Deke turns his missiles on the ship itself.
stages.whoA: The stowaway who turns his missiles
stages.whoB: The alien commander he outwits

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Quan calls Coulson when Chan disappears and briefs his team in Hong Kong. He joins Coulson's raid on the lab holding Chan, and Coulson later sends money to Quan's family.
stages.whoA: The agent who leads the rescue
stages.whoB: Chan's case agent in Hong Kong

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Quan raids the lab with Coulson and May to free Chan. He goes to help Chan and is killed in front of them.
stages.whoA: An agent on the raid with him
stages.whoB: The case agent killed on the raid

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Quan has caught Chan breaking his Index agreement and comes to rescue him from his captors. Chan, changed by them, burns a hole through Quan.
stages.whoA: The gifted man he watched, who kills him
stages.whoB: His S.H.I.E.L.D. case agent

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson chases Lumley in Mexico City and stops his escape with Lola. Lumley tells him about the mission that found Skye, and Coulson lets him leave S.H.I.E.L.D. and relocates him.
stages.whoA: The agent who tracks him down
stages.whoB: The old agent who knew Skye's past

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: May runs Lumley down in Mexico City, fights him and stops him taking a cyanide pill. Back on the Bus, she hears his story of the Hunan mission.
stages.whoA: The agent who catches him
stages.whoB: The old agent she chases

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: May, posing as agent Chastity McBryde, flirts with Stoner in 1973 and knocks him out at the Insight launch. Later he learns her name is Melinda, she saves him from the Chronicoms, and he offers to buy her a drink.
stages.whoA: The agent who knocks him out, then saves him
stages.whoB: The general she fools, then wins over

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Coulson warns Stoner that HYDRA and time traveling aliens have infiltrated Insight, but Stoner arrests him. When the Chronicoms take his men's faces, Stoner believes Coulson and helps fight them.
stages.whoA: The 'saboteur' who turns out right
stages.whoB: The general who arrests him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: In the fight at the Lighthouse, Stoner grabs a Chronicom rifle and kills a Chronicom that is about to kill Mack.
stages.whoA: The agent whose life he saves
stages.whoB: The general who saves his life

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Deke trained Ronnie as one of his secret agents and introduces him to Mack. After Ronnie runs from Sibyl, Deke tells him he still has a place on the team.
stages.whoA: His bandleader and squad leader
stages.whoB: A squad member he trained

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Ronnie idolizes Mack from Deke's stories and copies his fighting style. When Mack takes charge, Ronnie searches the Lighthouse for robots on his orders.
stages.whoA: The Director he idolizes
stages.whoB: A squad member who idolizes him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Ronnie and his brother fire on one of Sibyl's robots to force it back onto the bomb Olga planted. It blows up.
stages.whoA: The squad's demolitions expert
stages.whoB: A squad member who sets up her bomb

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Lorelei meets Rooster at his wife's bar and makes him and his bikers serve her. At her word he silences his wife, and he swears to fight for her when S.H.I.E.L.D. arrives.
stages.whoA: The Asgardian who enthralls him
stages.whoB: The biker leader she enthralls

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Ward faces Rooster in the bar fight and mocks his name. He tells Rooster to kneel, then takes him down.
stages.whoA: The agent who beats him
stages.whoB: A biker under Lorelei's spell

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Sif comes to the bar for Lorelei with S.H.I.E.L.D., and Rooster warns Lorelei about the woman with a sword. Lorelei orders her men to tear Sif apart.
stages.whoA: The Asgardian warrior hunting Lorelei
stages.whoB: One of Lorelei's enthralled men

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Roxy confronts Mack for abandoning the boy she thinks is his son, then hides with him from a robot and helps him destroy two. Later she greets him at the Lighthouse as an Academy recruit.
stages.whoA: The Director she scolds, then fights beside
stages.whoB: Deke's tactician who calls him out

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Roxy plays guitar in Deke's band and runs tactics for his squad. She tells Mack that Deke is her buddy and his too.
stages.whoA: Her bandleader and buddy
stages.whoB: His band's guitarist and tactician

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Roxy holds a robot back while Olga plants a bomb under it. At the victory party Olga tells Roxy she loves her, in Russian, so Roxy does not understand.
stages.whoA: A bandmate who loves her
stages.whoB: The bandmate she loves

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: Coulson, then a voice on a TV, helps the Deke Squad work out why Sibyl's robots attacked the Lighthouse. Later he congratulates Roxy on getting into the Academy.
stages.whoA: The digital Coulson who backs the squad
stages.whoB: A Deke Squad member turned recruit

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Ruben backs the Watchdogs and fights with Mack about money and Inhumans, then sees him working with Daisy. When Watchdogs attack their home, the brothers fight them off together.
stages.whoA: His older brother
stages.whoB: His younger brother

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
stages.text: In an altered past, Mack sets out with Deke to meet young Ruben and his own child self, posing as a friend from Deke's band. Deke says the brothers are even closer in this timeline.
stages.whoA: His brother, now a grown stranger
stages.whoB: His brother as a boy in an altered past

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Ruben sees Daisy use her powers at the raid and is disgusted. After the attack on the house, she tells him his brother is a good man she trusts.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman agent his brother protects
stages.whoB: Mack's brother

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Voss greets Deke warmly and lies that his father Owen will return. When Deke sees through it, Voss locks him up, and Deke later learns Voss killed Owen but spares him.
stages.whoA: The man who killed his father
stages.whoB: Owen Shaw's son

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Voss shows Daisy footage of herself on the day Earth broke apart and tries to kill her so she cannot go home. Daisy and Coulson stop him.
stages.whoA: The woman he blames for Earth's end
stages.whoB: The survivor who tries to kill her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Voss lives among the survivors with the aged Robin. When she moves to tell the team what they need to go home, he stabs her.
stages.whoA: The aged seer he stabs
stages.whoB: The survivor who kills her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Voss shows Coulson and May his armory and urges an attack on the Kree. After he attacks Daisy, Coulson holds him prisoner, then frees him with a warning.
stages.whoA: The leader who frees him
stages.whoB: The survivor he lets go

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Robbie finds Santino Noguera reading in his cell at South Ridge and presses him about the Fifth Street drive-by that crippled Gabe. Santino says it was a hit and everyone who knew who ordered it is dead. Robbie says one is left, and the Ghost Rider burns him alive.
stages.whoA: The Ghost Rider, who burns him alive
stages.whoB: A Fifth Street Locos inmate he kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Sequoia dates Deke and films him at his company, nagging him to get boba. When Sarge's crew attacks, Deke comes back for her and she slaps him for taking so long. Afterward she leaves him for Trevor.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend, until she leaves him
stages.whoB: His girlfriend, who leaves him for Trevor

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Trevor works beside Sequoia's boyfriend Deke as his assistant. When the building is attacked, Mack hands her to Trevor, who gets her out while she films it. She thanks him for saving her life and they start dating.
stages.whoA: The agent who saves her, now her boyfriend
stages.whoB: Deke's girlfriend, whom he saves and dates

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Seth and Donnie build a freezing machine at the Academy to sell to Ian Quinn, and Seth stages the attacks to bring Fitz in. Seth pushes the shy Donnie through the demonstration. When the storm runs wild, Seth helps Donnie shut it down and is killed by lightning.
stages.whoA: His partner in the freezing machine
stages.whoB: The classmate who used him, killed by their storm

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Quinn secretly pays for Seth and Donnie's freezing research, shipped through Seth's father. When S.H.I.E.L.D. gets involved, Quinn calls off the deal, and Seth begs him to stay for a demonstration that becomes a deadly storm.
stages.whoA: The tycoon buying his machine
stages.whoB: A cadet selling him a freezing machine

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Seth stages the Academy attacks so that Fitz will come and help fix the machine's power problem. When Fitz finds the device in Donnie's room, Seth knocks him out and flees to meet Quinn.
stages.whoA: The alumnus he tricks and knocks out
stages.whoB: A cadet who knocks him out

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Snowflake fights May in the jewelry vault and again at Deke's company, where Sarge takes May prisoner. May later knocks her out and brings her and Sarge in. When Sarge leaves Snowflake to die, she helps May and Daisy with his bomb.
stages.whoA: The agent she fights and admires
stages.whoB: A knife fighter of Sarge's crew

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Snowflake first comes at Deke with her knives when Sarge's crew attacks his company. On Sarge's truck she flirts with him, and they sleep together. After she is locked up, Deke brings her a television to keep things going.
stages.whoA: Her new lover, Deke
stages.whoB: Snowflake, his killer girlfriend

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Hunter looks up his old partner Spud to get a meeting with HYDRA. Spud says he must win a fight club bout, then steps into the ring himself to pay Hunter back for years of mockery. Hunter puts on knuckle dusters and kills him.
stages.whoA: His old partner, who kills him
stages.whoB: An old partner who turns on him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Stephanie shoots clay with her father and steadies him when he fears HYDRA's god will kill him, telling him to man up. The god shows her that Gideon cheated to avoid being sacrificed. Then he kills her before Gideon's eyes.
stages.whoA: Her father, Gideon
stages.whoB: His daughter, Stephanie

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: HYDRA's god, wearing Ward's body, comes to the Malick home and has Stephanie gather HYDRA's leaders, and she welcomes him as her family's god. He gives her a copy of Paradise Lost, then shows her how her father lied. Saying he still needs a Malick, he kisses her and kills her.
stages.whoA: The god she serves, who kills her
stages.whoB: Gideon's daughter, whom he kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tess shows Coulson how the Lighthouse works and takes him to Virgil's room. She flies the Trawler with him, May and Mack to Virgil's coordinates. After she is brought back to life, Coulson tells her about his own return before she leaves with the refugees.
stages.whoA: The time traveler she guides
stages.whoB: A Lighthouse trader who guides him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tess is an old friend of Deke and of Virgil, and is angry to hear Virgil is dead. She pays Deke double to help the people from the past. At the end she asks Flint if Deke really died to save them.
stages.whoA: An old friend on the Lighthouse
stages.whoB: An old friend on the Lighthouse

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tess trades with Flint and calms him before his Terrigenesis, and the Kree kill her for it. Brought back, she tells him he can help save the world. They lead the survivors down to rebuild Earth together.
stages.whoA: Flint, the boy she protects
stages.whoB: Tess, the trader who looks out for him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tess shoots Holt to save Mack and the others during the Renewal. After Kasius brings her back as his messenger, Mack and Yo-Yo send her back to him with their answer. She escapes Kasius with them and leads the refugees out.
stages.whoA: One of the agents from the past
stages.whoB: A Lighthouse trader who helps them

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Kasius has Tess brought back from death and sends her to the rebels with his demands. When she returns with their answer, he chokes her in anger. She gets away from him in the blast on his level.
stages.whoA: The Kree overseer who uses her
stages.whoB: A dead trader he revives as messenger

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: May takes Hannah off the downed Bus to draw Tobias away from the team, and he attacks her in a barn. May tells him he is trapped between two worlds and that he must let Hannah go. He lets go and drifts away.
stages.whoA: The agent who talks him into letting go
stages.whoB: The ghostly technician she fights

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Jemma studies the blast and sees a window into another world, and Tobias appears and swings his wrench at her. She works out that someone else is on the plane. Later he shoves her and Fitz into a closet.
stages.whoA: The scientist he attacks on the Bus
stages.whoB: The unseen man who attacks her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calderon sits on Gonzales's council and wants Hunter thrown in the brig. He backs Gonzales's takeover of the Playground and pushes to bring in Skye. Gonzales sends him with Bobbi to capture her.
stages.whoA: Robert Gonzales, who leads his S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: An agent on his council

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calderon needles Bobbi over letting Hunter escape. They lead the team sent to bring in Skye, and he ignores her order to carry only ICERs. When he fires a live round, Skye's blast throws them both.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent who leads the hunt with him
stages.whoB: A council agent who defies her orders

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calderon sees Skye's powers as a danger and leads the hunt for her. When he finds her he fires a live round, and her power turns it into a blast that spears him with a tree branch.
stages.whoA: Skye, the powered agent he shoots at
stages.whoB: An agent who tries to shoot her

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Calderon and Weaver sit together on Gonzales's council. Weaver tells Jemma that Calderon brought a squadron of Quinjets to save the Academy from HYDRA. They take over the Playground side by side.
stages.whoA: A fellow council member he once saved
stages.whoB: The agent who saved her Academy

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tony and Mack were Academy roommates, the Saint and the Sinner. When S.H.I.E.L.D. corners him, he drops his guns once he sees Mack. He takes Mack to Joseph Getty and later finds Deathlok files for him.
stages.whoA: His old Academy roommate, Mack
stages.whoB: Tony Caine, his old roommate

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tony shoots at Daisy and Coulson when they find him, then helps them track down Getty. Later he hands Daisy a Centipede device, serum and Deathlok files, and helps her hide Robin and Polly.
stages.whoA: The agent he brings Centipede files
stages.whoB: Mack's old friend, a fixer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Coulson tracks Tony down through the death certificates he signed for Cybertek scientists. Tony helps the team find the Principia, and Coulson thanks him before he goes.
stages.whoA: Coulson, who thanks him for his help
stages.whoB: A fixer who helps him find gravitonium

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Coulson questions Diaz about the Chitauri helmet and learns he is infected, not a killer. He sits with Diaz, shares what he knows about dying, and leaves only when Diaz tells him to go.
stages.whoA: The agent who sits with him at the end
stages.whoB: An infected firefighter he comforts

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Bobbi visits Toshiro in Okinawa under her HYDRA cover and gets him bragging about the Splinter Bombs. When word comes that she is S.H.I.E.L.D., he turns on her, and she shoots him with Hunter.
stages.whoA: Bobbi, an old friend who is S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoB: A HYDRA engineer she plays for intel

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Hunter watches Bobbi charm Mori from the van, sulking. When Mori's guards move in, Hunter and May come in shooting, and Hunter fires with Bobbi to kill Mori.
stages.whoA: An agent who shoots him
stages.whoB: The HYDRA engineer he helps kill

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Trevor plays Deke's assistant and best friend while spying on him for S.H.I.E.L.D. When Sarge attacks, he reveals he is an agent and gets Deke out, and Deke is hurt that he called Mack. Back at the Lighthouse he keeps watch over the sedated Deke.
stages.whoA: The boss he spies on as a friend
stages.whoB: His assistant, secretly an agent

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Mack has Trevor watch Deke undercover, and Trevor calls him in when Sarge appears. Mack has him clear civilians and get Sequoia out. Later Mack and Daisy save him when Jaco breathes fire.
stages.whoA: Director Mackenzie, his boss
stages.whoB: An agent he sends undercover

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tye orders Quake to show her powers or Simmons will pay, and she slams him into a wall. Dosed with odium, he fights her and Coulson. Quake kills him with his own knife.
stages.whoA: Quake, who kills him
stages.whoB: Kasius's trainer, whom she kills

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Tye trains Inhumans to fight for Kasius's profit and reports on Abby's failures. When the Lighthouse rises up, he tells Kasius the Inhumans are not ready. Kasius forces odium on him and sends him after the agents.
stages.whoA: Kasius, who owns his fighters
stages.whoB: His trainer of Inhuman fighters

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Raging on odium, Tye attacks Coulson and Daisy and shrugs off their ICER shots. He cuts Coulson with his knife before Daisy kills him.
stages.whoA: An agent he cuts in a fight
stages.whoB: Kasius's odium-crazed trainer

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: After the Quinjet crash, Mace bluffs Orlov with a case only he can open and offers to talk it through. Orlov says his men could just kill him and take it, and they open fire.
stages.whoA: The Director he hunts after the crash
stages.whoB: The merc leader who hunts him after the crash

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Mack wrecks the jamming truck Orlov's men guard, and Orlov comes after him in close combat. Mack holds on until May arrives, and together they beat Orlov.
stages.whoA: The agent who wrecks his truck and beats him
stages.whoB: The merc leader he beats with May

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: May flies in to rescue Mace's party and finds Orlov fighting Mack. Together they take him down, though he wounds her in the fight.
stages.whoA: The agent who takes him down with Mack
stages.whoB: A merc leader who wounds her in a fight

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Virgil finds Coulson just after the monolith sends him away and tells him he is one of the True Believers, who believe in him. Before he can explain more, Mack knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. hero he always believed in
stages.whoB: A True Believer who greets him on arrival

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Mack sees Virgil standing over Coulson with a strange gun and punches him out. When Virgil wakes, he greets Mack by his full name as a hero he has studied for years.
stages.whoA: The agent who knocked him out
stages.whoB: A stranger he punched, who knew his name

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Virgil names Simmons and her field and tells her Fitz is thinking of her. He is explaining why the team was brought there when a Vrellnexian kills him.
stages.whoA: An agent he knew from his studies
stages.whoB: A stranger who knew her and Fitz

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Virgil greets Yo-Yo by name and asks if he can call her Yo-Yo, and she says no. Moments later a Vrellnexian kills him in front of the team.
stages.whoA: An agent he knew from his studies
stages.whoB: A stranger who knew her name

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Fitz poses as a Sivian engineer on Viro's ship until Viro exposes him as a Terran. Fitz bargains to work for free, then stands against Viro's plan to space the crew and tricks him into opening the wrong airlock.
stages.whoA: The Terran engineer who tricked him
stages.whoB: The captain who made him work for free

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6
stages.text: Viro finds Enoch hiding aboard with Fitz and spares them both as unpaid labor. Enoch warns Fitz that going against Viro means joining the crew in the airlock, then sees Viro die by his own hand.
stages.whoA: Fitz's stowaway, kept as free labor
stages.whoB: The captain who held him and Fitz

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Cal calls Levi an old buddy, frees him of his S.H.I.E.L.D. chip, and has him decrypt the Index to find the rest of the team. Levi hacks Brynmore and a high school for Cal's showdown with Coulson.
stages.whoA: His old friend and team leader
stages.whoB: An old buddy who hacks for his team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Coulson reads out Levi's file, a genius with no moral compass. At the high school, Levi begs Coulson not to hit him, and Coulson knocks him out.
stages.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Director who knocks him out
stages.whoB: A genius hacker on Cal's team

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Daisy catches Zaikin after he shoots at Mace. She reads out his record in the interrogation room, but he will not name his supplier.
stages.whoA: The agent who caught him
stages.whoB: An ex-Hydra sniper she caught

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Talbot tries to break Zaikin, who calls him glass to Hydra's hammer. Talbot brings in Simmons, and Zaikin admits the Watchdogs hired him.
stages.whoA: The general who interrogates him
stages.whoB: An ex-Hydra assassin he breaks

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Zaikin mocks Talbot for bringing a woman to scare him. Simmons shows him what happened to the last Hydra operative they caught, and he gives up the Watchdogs.
stages.whoA: The scientist who scares him into talking
stages.whoB: A captured assassin she scares into talking

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Zaikin fires exploding bullets at Director Mace at a public event but misses. Once he talks, S.H.I.E.L.D. learns the plan was to bring down Mace's Quinjet.
stages.whoA: The Director he tried to kill
stages.whoB: The sniper who tried to kill him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Fitz walks into Hadad's den to trade a locked case for a scroll casing tied to the monolith. Hadad hands it over for splinter bombs, but the bomb he throws is a flash grenade and Fitz escapes.
stages.whoA: The Scot who tricked him in a trade
stages.whoB: A broker of looted relics

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Zev is Grill's right-hand man at the salvage and keeps the new workers in line. Grill sends him on the Trawler run to find proof of stealing, then believes he hid a gun and has him punished as a violator.
stages.whoA: His boss at the salvage
stages.whoB: His right-hand man

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Zev shocks Mack at the salvage and gives him a hard time on the Trawler. When Zev pins the agents with their Metrics, Mack knocks him out and locks him up.
stages.whoA: A new worker he bullies
stages.whoB: Grill's enforcer, who bullies him

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Zev shocks Yo-Yo for working too slowly and calls her new girl. After his sabotage, she plants a gun on him with her speed, and Grill has him killed.
stages.whoA: The new girl who frames him
stages.whoB: Grill's enforcer, whom she frames

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Zev walks Coulson's group through Grill's salvage as new workers and rides along on their Trawler run. When they find Virgil's hidden radio, he pins them to the walls with their Metrics.
stages.whoA: A new worker on the Trawler run
stages.whoB: Grill's enforcer at the salvage

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Ava tells how her father Elihas Starr kept up his quantum work after Hank Pym had him fired. When his tunnel overloads he tells her to run, but she stays, and the blast kills her parents and leaves her phasing in pain.
stages.whoA: His daughter, Ava
stages.whoB: Her father, a fired S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Elihas Starr and Hank Pym are colleagues in quantum research at S.H.I.E.L.D. until Hank has him fired and discredited. Ava blames Hank for her father's fate, while Hank calls Starr a traitor who stole his plans.
stages.whoA: The colleague who had him fired
stages.whoB: A fired S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum brings Scott and Cassie to Jentorra and presses her to torture them. When Kang's forces strike, she orders him to get her people away. Later he hands her back her staff and fights beside her in the revolt.
stages.whoA: The leader of his rebels
stages.whoB: One of her rebels

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum and Quaz hold Scott and Cassie in the rebel camp. Quaz reads their minds and tells Xolum to stop suggesting they torture people.
stages.whoA: A telepath among the rebels
stages.whoB: A rebel who keeps urging torture

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum and Veb are among the rebels who greet Scott and Cassie after they drink the ooze. Both are taken prisoner in the raid on the camp and join the revolt against Kang.
stages.whoA: A fellow rebel
stages.whoB: A fellow rebel

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum saves Scott and Cassie from a monster, then wants Scott tortured as a spy. In the end he fights on the same side against Kang.
stages.whoA: A stranger he rescues and wants to torture
stages.whoB: A rebel who rescues him, then wants him tortured

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Xolum rescues Cassie and her father and urges the rebels to torture them. After Kang captures the rebels, Cassie frees them and calls the Quantum Realm to revolt, and Xolum fights in the uprising she starts.
stages.whoA: The girl who sparks the revolt
stages.whoB: A rebel who fights in her revolt

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Kang's forces raid the rebel camp and take Xolum prisoner. When the rebels rise up, Kang suits up and kills Xolum with a single blast to the head.
stages.whoA: The conqueror who kills him
stages.whoB: A rebel he kills

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Smitty oversees the dive that sends Salazar and Jackson to the vibranium detector on the seabed. Salazar reports that Jackson is gone and her signal dies as the ship comes under attack.
stages.whoA: A diver on his operation
stages.whoB: The officer running her dive

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: As a strange song lures the crew overboard, Smitty fights back with earplugs and a gun. Attuma drags a sailor into the sea and throws a spear that kills Smitty.
stages.whoA: The undersea warrior who kills him
stages.whoB: An American officer he kills

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Under Dreykov's control, Yelena hunts Oksana in Morocco for the antidote gas and stabs her. Dying, Oksana sprays Yelena with the gas, freeing her, and tells her to free the others.
stages.whoA: The Widow who kills her and is freed by her
stages.whoB: The older Widow she kills, who frees her

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Yelena leads a team of Widows in Morocco to take the antidote gas from Oksana, who sets off smoke and flees on foot. After Oksana dies, the team reports Yelena as a deserter.
stages.whoA: The Widows sent to take her antidote gas
stages.whoB: The older Widow whose antidote gas they hunt

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Agent Taylor guards President Ross at the White House summit, on his flight to Tokyo, where he orders her to get him to the Indian Ocean within the hour, and at Celestial Island. When Ross turns into a red Hulk at the Rose Garden, she opens fire on him.
stages.whoA: The President she guards
stages.whoB: Agent Taylor, who guards him

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Taylor brings Sam to Ross at the White House summit and tells him to keep an open mind. When the red Hulk buries Sam in rubble, she helps Ruth pull him out.
stages.whoA: Captain America, whom she brings to Ross
stages.whoB: Agent Taylor, Ross's guard

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Taylor and Ruth both serve President Ross. When the red Hulk knocks Sam into the rubble at the White House, the two of them pull him free together.
stages.whoA: Ross's adviser, who helps her rescue Sam
stages.whoB: Agent Taylor, Ross's guard

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Ross, who says he and Ozaki go back a long way, greets him at the White House summit, but Japan pulls out of the treaty after the attack there. In Tokyo, Ozaki accuses Ross of stealing Japan's adamantium, and over Celestial Island he refuses to believe the American pilots went rogue.
stages.whoA: The US President he blames for the theft
stages.whoB: Japan's prime minister, Ozaki

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Ross introduces Sam to Ozaki at the White House summit, and the two pose for a photo together. Later, Sam stops the rogue American pilots firing on Japan's fleet.
stages.whoA: Captain America, met at the summit
stages.whoB: Japan's prime minister, met at the summit

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Hodge and Steve are both recruits at Camp Lehigh, and Hodge is Phillips' favorite. When Phillips throws a dummy grenade, Hodge dives for cover while Steve throws himself on it.
stages.whoA: The skinny recruit picked over him
stages.whoB: The bully Phillips wanted to pick

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Hodge mocks Agent Carter's accent and makes a crude pass at her in front of the recruits. She has him step forward and knocks him to the ground.
stages.whoA: The officer who knocks him down
stages.whoB: The recruit she knocks down

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Phillips backs Hodge as his choice, saying he passed every test, is big and fast and obeys orders. Phillips' dummy grenade test ends up proving Steve the better man instead.
stages.whoA: The colonel who wants him chosen
stages.whoB: The recruit he wants chosen

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Anna tells her son Foggy that his father's arthritis is worsening and asks him to come home and help Theo with the shop. She later cheers his DA campaign video and celebrates with him before leaving for Tampa.
stages.whoA: Her son, a lawyer
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Anna worries that Theo cannot run Nelson's Meats alone and wants Foggy to help him. Theo joins the family as Anna watches Foggy's video, and he stays on when she and her husband retire.
stages.whoA: Her son, who runs the shop
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Arinori and Dex serve together on Fisk's FBI detail and both end up doing Kingpin's work. They clash at the church when Arinori blames Dex for failing to kill Karen. At the wedding, Dex kills Arinori with dining knives.
stages.whoA: His fellow agent, and his killer
stages.whoB: A fellow agent on Fisk's detail

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Arinori congratulates Nadeem on the Albanian raid and later shocks him by admitting that Fisk owns him too. Nadeem breaks up his fight with Dex at the church.
stages.whoA: His fellow FBI agent
stages.whoB: A fellow agent turned by Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Arinori lobbies Hattley for the Fisk case and later takes Kingpin's orders through her. She sends him to round up the city's crime bosses.
stages.whoA: His FBI boss
stages.whoB: An agent under her command

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Arinori escorts Fisk into the hotel and guards him, then becomes one of the agents Fisk controls. He brings Fisk the crime bosses and guards his wedding.
stages.whoA: The prisoner who controls him
stages.whoB: An FBI agent he controls

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Donovan visits Fisk at Rikers, warning him to keep his head down while he moves money on Fisk's orders. He also draws up the rules for Matt's visit.
stages.whoA: His client and employer
stages.whoB: His lawyer

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Donovan brings Fisk news of Vanessa and works his FBI deal. He gathers Dex's records for Fisk and announces that Fisk's conviction is overturned.
stages.whoA: His client and employer
stages.whoB: His lawyer

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Donovan hands Matt a contract in braille that sets the rules for his meeting with Fisk. He ends the visit when Matt's time is up.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who visited Fisk
stages.whoB: Fisk's lawyer

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Daredevil waits in Donovan's car and chokes him with a wire until he admits Fisk is doing it all for Vanessa. Donovan then tells Fisk that Daredevil is back.
stages.whoA: The vigilante who choked him
stages.whoB: Fisk's lawyer, who talked

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Donovan frees Cottonmouth for lack of evidence and mocks Misty's case. He then pulls Candace out of Misty's interview, and Misty calls him a snake.
stages.whoA: The cop he keeps beating
stages.whoB: Cottonmouth's slick lawyer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donovan gets Arturo Rey released and mocks Misty's arm. He shuts down her questioning of Mariah and later stands with Bushmaster against her.
stages.whoA: The cop he keeps beating
stages.whoB: The Stokes family's lawyer

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Donovan arrives at the precinct when Cottonmouth is held over Scarfe's murder. He gets him released for lack of evidence and walks him out.
stages.whoA: His client
stages.whoB: His lawyer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donovan quits Mariah when her money is gone, saying he was only loyal to her money. He wins her fortune back, defends her in court, passes on her kill orders and writes her will.
stages.whoA: His client
stages.whoB: Her family's lawyer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donovan represents Cockroach against Luke and sets a high price to settle. After Mariah's death, he reads her will and gives Luke Harlem's Paradise.
stages.whoA: The man he sued
stages.whoB: The Stokes family's lawyer

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Betsy is Melvin's parole officer and his girlfriend, which they keep secret. Melvin fears for her as Fisk threatens her to keep him working.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend
stages.whoB: His girlfriend and parole officer

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Daredevil finds Betsy at work, tells her Melvin was arrested, and warns her to run from Fisk. She calls him a cold piece of work, no better than Fisk.
stages.whoA: The vigilante who warned her
stages.whoB: The woman he warned to run

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Coach Bradley encourages young Dex and gives him a new glove. When Bradley pulls him from a near perfect game, Dex's angry throw kills him.
stages.whoA: His young pitcher, and his killer
stages.whoB: His boyhood coach

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: A neighbor tells Luke that Dontrell beats his girlfriend and son. She points him to Dontrell's dice game and offers him coffee.
stages.whoA: The hero she sent after Dontrell
stages.whoB: A neighbor who pointed him to Dontrell

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Mrs. Callahan comes to Foggy's campaign event at Nelson's Meats. She tells him Fisk's bombing killed her husband and gives him her absentee vote.
stages.whoA: The candidate she voted for
stages.whoB: A voter who lost her husband to Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: A well-dressed stranger tells Farnum his debt now belongs to the stranger's employer and shows him a live feed of his daughter. Farnum agrees to do the job, and when he fails, he is killed.
stages.whoA: The man who coerced him
stages.whoB: A cop he coerced

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Farnum slips into Karen's cell and tries to strangle her with a sheet to fake a suicide. She claws at his eye and calls for help.
stages.whoA: The woman he tried to kill
stages.whoB: The guard who tried to kill her

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Corbin's team corners the masked man at the Russian hideout, but he breaks free. Later Daredevil stops Corbin's hit on Hoffman.
stages.whoA: The masked man who foiled him
stages.whoB: A cop on Fisk's payroll

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Corbin leads crooked cops after Vladimir for Fisk and wounds him in the fight. Vladimir escapes with the masked man.
stages.whoA: The Russian he hunted
stages.whoB: The cop sent to kill him

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Corbin hunts down Hoffman, a fellow cop, and kills his bodyguards. Daredevil saves Hoffman, whose testimony gets Corbin arrested.
stages.whoA: The cop he tried to kill
stages.whoB: The cop sent to kill him

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Foggy defends Frank Castle in Batzer's court. She warns him and the DA over jury selection and hears his opening statement.
stages.whoA: Frank Castle's lawyer
stages.whoB: The judge at Frank's trial

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Matt defends Frank Castle in Batzer's court. When Matt puts Frank on the stand, Frank turns on everyone and she calls for order.
stages.whoA: Frank Castle's lawyer
stages.whoB: The judge at Frank's trial

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Reyes prosecutes Frank Castle before Batzer. Batzer pushes both sides to accept the jury and strikes the doctor's testimony after Reyes calls it a distraction.
stages.whoA: The DA prosecuting Frank
stages.whoB: The judge at Frank's trial

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Batzer takes Frank's surprise not guilty plea. His trial ends in chaos when he turns on the court on the stand.
stages.whoA: The defendant in her court
stages.whoB: The judge at his trial

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Daredevil finds Daniel at the Farm and returns him to his father. When the Hand takes back its patients, Daniel flees from Daredevil.
stages.whoA: The vigilante who rescued him
stages.whoB: A boy he rescued from the Hand

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Claire treats Daniel at Metro-General and finds he has no fingerprints. When he wakes, she tells him he is safe and brings in his father.
stages.whoA: The nurse who treated him
stages.whoB: A patient taken by the Hand

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Doris and Ben flirt and joke in her hospital room as her illness clouds her memory. When he is fired, she urges him to tell his story online.
stages.whoA: Her husband, a reporter
stages.whoB: His ailing wife, Doris

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: At Ben's funeral, Karen blames herself for his death. Doris tells her Ben admired her and always made his own choices.
stages.whoA: The young woman Ben looked after
stages.whoB: Ben's widow

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Dutton comes to Fisk's cell at Rikers to warn him that he runs the prison and calls himself its kingpin. Fisk buys the guards out from under him, sends Frank to his cell, and sits at his bedside as he dies.
stages.whoA: The new inmate who takes his prison from him
stages.whoB: The Rikers boss he has killed to take over

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Frank corners Dutton in his cell and makes him talk about the Central Park deal he brokered. Dutton names the Blacksmith and warns that Frank's crusade will never end, and Frank stabs him.
stages.whoA: The inmate who stabs him for answers
stages.whoB: The Rikers boss who names the Blacksmith

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Dr. Mercer treats young Dex after he kills his coach and teaches him routines and empathy. Facing her death, she gives him tapes of their sessions and tells him to find a good person to look up to.
stages.whoA: The boy she treats for years
stages.whoB: The psychiatrist who raised him on routines

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: FBI agents bring Starr to Fisk's restaurant meeting, where Fisk offers the bosses protection for a cut of everything. Starr calls it a con and walks out, and is killed before he reaches the door.
stages.whoA: The kingpin whose offer he refuses
stages.whoB: A crime boss killed for refusing his tax

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Dex helps round up the crime bosses for Fisk's meeting. When Starr refuses Fisk's offer and turns to leave, Dex, in Daredevil's suit, kills him with a thrown baton.
stages.whoA: The man in Daredevil's suit who kills him
stages.whoB: A crime boss he kills for Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Karen finds George after he is fired from Metro-General and offers to help him get his job back. He tells her how the John Doe woke up and made him drive him home, and gives her the address.
stages.whoA: The woman digging into the John Doe
stages.whoB: The fired nurse who drove the John Doe home

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Gosnell taunts Frank by name as his men open fire on him at the pier. Their gunfire sets off the gunpowder below decks and Gosnell dies in the blast. Schoonover later recalls him as a loyal Marine.
stages.whoA: The old comrade he ambushes at the pier
stages.whoB: A scarred former Marine who ambushes him

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Karen and Ellison find Tepper after he steps down and ask what he knows. He identifies the John Doe in Karen's photo and tells her the man was an undercover cop.
stages.whoA: The reporter who gets him to talk
stages.whoB: The medical examiner who IDs the John Doe

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Ellison comes to Tepper's door with Karen and urges him to help expose the real culprits. Tepper agrees to talk if they check his story before they print a word of it.
stages.whoA: The editor who comes to his door with Karen
stages.whoB: A frightened source he and Karen visit

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Hirochi hosts Elektra at Roxxon to discuss her father's money and greets her at the company's gala. That night she and Matt steal the ledger from his office.
stages.whoA: The heiress who steals his ledger
stages.whoB: The Roxxon man after her father's money

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Matt attends Hirochi's gala as Elektra's date. As Daredevil he later seizes Hirochi at the Farm, then storms the room where Hirochi is torturing Stick.
stages.whoA: The masked man who storms his Farm
stages.whoB: The Hand leader he confronts at the Farm

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Hirochi oversees Stick's torture, driving sticks under his nails to find the Chaste. When Daredevil attacks, Hirochi goes for Stick's throat, and Stick bites out his instead.
stages.whoA: The captive who tears out his throat
stages.whoB: The Hand leader who tortures him

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Nobu leads the Hand in New York with Hirochi at his side. After Daredevil frees their captives, the two retake them and bleed them dry for the Hand's plan.
stages.whoA: The Hand leader he serves
stages.whoB: His lieutenant posing as a Roxxon man

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Lim works Fisk's hotel detail beside Dex, mourning Garcia and laughing at Dex's prank on Fisk's lunch. At the wedding Dex finds him at the garage, calls him one of the good ones and knocks him out.
stages.whoA: His partner on Fisk's detail
stages.whoB: A fellow agent on Fisk's detail

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: This agent guards Fisk in his hotel suite, serves him dinner with an insult and checks his rooms. He watches on the monitors as Fisk eats a burger Dex has already bitten.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he guards at the hotel
stages.whoB: An agent guarding his hotel suite

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Jacques flirts with Elektra at an airport bar, then reveals he knows her kills. They fight, she stabs him with his own sai, and he tells her that Stick sent him.
stages.whoA: The target he is sent to kill
stages.whoB: The assassin Stick sends to kill her

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Karen visits Mrs. Fisher and asks her to stand up to Union Allied together. Mrs. Fisher says she already signed the company's deal for her kids' sake and warns Karen to let it go.
stages.whoA: Daniel's coworker, who asks her to fight back
stages.whoB: Daniel Fisher's widow

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: FBI agents drag Hammer to Fisk's restaurant meeting, where Fisk offers protection for a cut and raises the tax when Starr refuses. Hammer agrees to pay, then grumbles at being summoned to Fisk's wedding.
stages.whoA: The kingpin who taxes his business
stages.whoB: A crime boss paying his tax

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Dex leads the raid on Hammer's garage, stops his escape with a thrown wrench and drags him off. At the restaurant, Dex then kills Starr in front of Hammer and the other bosses.
stages.whoA: The agent who knocks him down in a raid
stages.whoB: A crime boss he arrests for Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Hammer and Rosalie wait together at the restaurant, guessing why the FBI took them there so quietly. At Fisk's wedding she hands him champagne when he complains about Fisk.
stages.whoA: A fellow boss caught in Fisk's net
stages.whoB: A fellow boss paying Fisk's tax

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: An agent guarding Fisk at the hotel secretly works for him, driving him around the city. When Fisk kills Wellers in the car, the agent dumps the body, then hunts Nadeem on his orders.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he secretly serves
stages.whoB: A corrupt agent who drives for him

stages.title: Daredevil S3
