stages.text: Imada asks Trish to fill in blanks in Jessica's story outside the funeral home. Trish accuses her of trying to pin Nussbaumer's death on Jessica.
stages.whoA: A grieving witness she questions about Jessica
stages.whoB: A detective who questions her about Jessica

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: On his mother's orders Dwayne drops Erik into the pool tied to weights over a short payment. When Erik comes back late, Dwayne throws him in again with three weights.
stages.whoA: The debtor he drowns for his mother
stages.whoB: Sal's son, who throws him in the pool

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: As Dwayne throws Erik into the pool again, a masked Trish storms the yard and beats him. He gets up to find his mother badly hurt.
stages.whoA: The masked woman who beats him
stages.whoB: The bookie's son she beats

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Mrs. De Luca greets Jessica at her old family home and shares stories of her childhood and old gossip with Kilgrave. Under Kilgrave's control she later carries a bomb to Simpson and dies.
stages.whoA: The neighbor girl she watched grow up
stages.whoB: Her family's old next-door neighbor

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Kilgrave invites Mrs. De Luca to breakfast, makes her admit she lies to feel important, and sends her away. He then orders her to hand Simpson his own bomb, and she dies in the blast.
stages.whoA: The man who controls her and sends her to die
stages.whoB: The neighbor he turns into a bomb

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Controlled by Kilgrave, Mrs. De Luca stops Simpson outside the Jones house and hands him a bag holding his own bomb. It goes off as he runs, killing her and his two men.
stages.whoA: The officer she brings Kilgrave's bomb
stages.whoB: The neighbor who brings him his bomb

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Gina picks Luke up at his bar and sleeps with him. Learning she is married, he turns her away, and her husband Andre brings his rugby team to beat Luke.
stages.whoA: The bar owner she has an affair with
stages.whoB: A married woman he sleeps with

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Gina storms Jessica's office over the photos of her with Luke and accuses her of chasing off the competition. Jessica grabs her arm, and Gina reveals Andre's team is on its way to Luke's bar.
stages.whoA: The investigator who photographed her affair
stages.whoB: Luke's married lover, who blames her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gor collects Brianna's cut on the street and grabs her for holding money back. He takes her out of Malcolm's apartment, then loses her when Malcolm beats him.
stages.whoA: A woman he runs on the street
stages.whoB: The pimp she works for

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gor punches Malcolm and takes Brianna back out of his apartment. Malcolm later finds him on the street, beats him down and leaves with Brianna.
stages.whoA: The man who beats him and takes Brianna
stages.whoB: Brianna's pimp, whom he beats

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Grace co-hosts Trish's style program on ARN and plays along when Trish rambles about Mother's Day on air. After Dorothy's murder she welcomes Trish back and praises her strength.
stages.whoA: The star she co-hosts with on ARN
stages.whoB: Her co-host on ARN

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Dorothy warns Grace on set that her blouse shows too much. Later Trish brings Dorothy on air, and Grace welcomes her as a guest.
stages.whoA: Trish's mother, a guest on air
stages.whoB: Trish's co-host

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica stops Spheeris's car by lifting it, and he threatens to tell the world about her. She mocks him with talk of laser eyes and serves him the subpoena.
stages.whoA: The strong woman who serves him
stages.whoB: A club owner she serves with a subpoena

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Griffin dates Trish and panics when she vanishes chasing IGH, then copies a list of names from her computer. He stages a surprise proposal, and she ends the relationship.
stages.whoA: The girlfriend he proposes to
stages.whoB: Her reporter boyfriend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Griffin helps bail Jessica out and trades dark jokes with her, then turns to her when Trish goes missing. He lures her to his proposal party with a call saying Trish is in trouble.
stages.whoA: Trish's best friend
stages.whoB: Trish's boyfriend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Griffin lunches with Trish and Dorothy, then enlists Dorothy to bring Trish to his surprise proposal.
stages.whoA: Trish's mother, who helps with his proposal
stages.whoB: Trish's boyfriend

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Inez trades scraps of IGH information for shelter at Jeri's home, then sells her the lie that Shane can heal her ALS. They become lovers until Inez and Shane rob Jeri, and Jeri tricks Inez into shooting Shane.
stages.whoA: The lawyer she seduces and robs
stages.whoB: The con artist she falls for

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica tracks Inez down and learns she was an IGH nurse whose patient broke her back. Jessica arranges for Jeri to keep her safe.
stages.whoA: The investigator chasing IGH
stages.whoB: A former IGH nurse she protects

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish helps Jessica find Inez and hears her story of the IGH patient who nearly killed her.
stages.whoA: Jessica's sister, chasing IGH
stages.whoB: A former IGH nurse she helps find

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Inez runs from Malcolm and steals his television. He catches her trying to sell it and takes her to Jeri.
stages.whoA: The man who catches her and takes her to Jeri
stages.whoB: The nurse who steals his television

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Masked, Trish corners Montero at his building and beats a confession out of him. He admits his fires killed 14 people and dies under her blows.
stages.whoA: The masked vigilante who kills him
stages.whoB: An arsonist she beats to death

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica visits Jack posing as a transit investigator. Unable to speak, he spells KIL to confirm Kilgrave, then writes a plea for her to kill him, which she refuses.
stages.whoA: The investigator who asks who took his kidneys
stages.whoB: Kilgrave's mute victim

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Jessica corners Justis on the golf course, and he refuses to give up Malus. She then confronts his son Eric, and Justis agrees to tell her where Malus is.
stages.whoA: The investigator who threatens his son
stages.whoB: Malus's loyal patron

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Justis pays Malus's bills out of gratitude for saving his son. After Jessica's visit he calls to warn Malus about her.
stages.whoA: The doctor who saved his son
stages.whoB: The old friend who pays his bills

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Trish sings at Kyle's daughter's birthday party in exchange for a hospital file. Kyle hands over the pages he copied on Jessica, all he could find.
stages.whoA: The star who sings for his daughter
stages.whoB: The hospital guard who trades her a file

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Laurent turns Jeri away after his father's death and knocks her down, then apologizes. Later he comes to her office and asks her to protect his mother from the lawsuits.
stages.whoA: The lawyer he blames, then asks for help
stages.whoB: Kith's son

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Luke beats up Sirkes's men, then talks Sirkes into a finder's deal for Antoine. At the warehouse Sirkes gets Luke in a headlock, but Luke throws a table at him and his men.
stages.whoA: The strongman who cuts a deal, then beats him
stages.whoB: The loan shark Antoine owes

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica mocks Sirkes as a would-be Carl Icahn while Luke strikes a deal. At the warehouse she refuses to hand Antoine over and fights off his men.
stages.whoA: The investigator hired to find Antoine
stages.whoB: A loan shark she defies

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Dr. Hansen works under Malus at IGH as he treats Alisa. She worries about Alisa's rages and tries to sedate her, but Malus sends her out.
stages.whoA: The IGH scientist she works under
stages.whoB: A doctor on his IGH team

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Inez is a new nurse at IGH when her patient Alisa throws her into a glass cabinet and breaks her back. Alisa then kills Luanne, the other nurse.
stages.whoA: The IGH patient who broke her back
stages.whoB: A nurse she nearly killed at IGH

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Erik borrows from Sal and keeps paying late, so she has him weighted and dropped in her pool. Three hours late again, he is thrown back in until the masked vigilante attacks.
stages.whoA: A gambler who always pays late
stages.whoB: His bookie, who drowns late payers

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Masked, Trish storms Sal's house to pull Erik out of the pool. Sal swings a crowbar at her and ends up impaled on it, and Trish apologizes as she flees.
stages.whoA: The masked vigilante who crashed her house
stages.whoB: A bookie impaled during a rescue

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Serena asks Luke to find her missing brother Antoine in exchange for the file on the crash that killed Reva. When Antoine is home, she hands Luke the name Charles Wallace.
stages.whoA: Found her brother in exchange for the bus file
stages.whoB: Traded him the name of Reva's bus driver

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica brings Antoine home to Serena and demands what she promised Luke. Once Luke leaves with the driver's name, Jessica tells Serena he is going to kill that man.
stages.whoA: The P.I. who brought her brother home
stages.whoB: Antoine's sister, Luke's client

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Cellmates Sissy and Hope watch their prison TV show together. Hope pays Sissy fifty bucks and a pack of smokes to beat her, and Sissy nearly kills her.
stages.whoA: Her cellmate, who paid for a beating
stages.whoB: Her cellmate, paid to beat her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica visits Sissy in prison after Hope's beating and slams her into a vending machine. Sissy admits she only did what Hope paid her to do.
stages.whoA: The visitor who slammed her into a machine
stages.whoB: Hope's cellmate and attacker

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sonia and her ex-husband Oscar fight over custody of their son Vido. When she leaves with Vido and suitcases, Oscar tracks her to the bus station with Jessica.
stages.whoA: Her ex-husband, Vido's father
stages.whoB: His ex-wife, Vido's mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sonia drags Vido home after finding him hanging from Jessica's window. Later she takes him onto a bus to Montreal, then agrees to stay.
stages.whoA: Her son
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Sonia distrusts Jessica after seeing Vido dangling from her window. Jessica helps Oscar track Sonia to the bus station and stop her leaving with Vido.
stages.whoA: The neighbor she doesn't trust near Vido
stages.whoB: Vido's mother

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Benowitz and Chao use Jeri's scandal and her illness to push her out of the firm. Jeri digs for dirt and uses a tape of Chao laundering money to double her severance, promising not to out Steven.
stages.whoA: His name partner, pushed out of the firm
stages.whoB: A name partner pushing her out

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Benowitz delivers client transfer papers to Jeri's new firm in person, taking Rand Enterprises. He thanks her for telling him to come out and urges her to slow down.
stages.whoA: His old partner, now a rival firm
stages.whoB: Her old partner, poaching her clients

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Malcolm finds Benowitz at a Chelsea bar and, instead of blackmailing him, tells him to go home and tell his wife the truth. Jeri later reveals Malcolm was working for her.
stages.whoA: Jeri's investigator who trailed him
stages.whoB: Jeri's partner he trailed to a bar

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Stirling meets Jessica at his bar, quits with a bottle of whiskey, and they start dating. He agrees to lend her muscle to Wyatt, and she finds him dead in an alley.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, who dreamed of Club Alias

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Wyatt invested in Stirling's Club Alias and comes for his money until Jessica beats him and his men. He then offers to forgive the debt for Jessica as muscle, and Stirling agrees for a cut.
stages.whoA: The investor demanding his money back
stages.whoB: The bartender who owes him

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Alisa overhears Stirling selling Jessica's muscle to Wyatt and confronts him outside. Calling herself Jessica's mother, she beats him to death against a wall.
stages.whoA: Jessica's mother, his killer
stages.whoB: Jessica's boyfriend, whom she killed

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Wyatt shoves Stirling around over his debt until Jessica throws him and his men out. Wanting her strength for his jobs, he cuts a deal with Stirling, but the cops arrest him after Stirling's death.
stages.whoA: Stirling's girlfriend, who beat his crew
stages.whoB: Stirling's investor, who wanted her as muscle

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jessica and Erik pose as couriers to ask Todd why he paid a blackmail note. She finds his photos of young girls, locks him in a closet and calls the police.
stages.whoA: The P.I. who exposed him
stages.whoB: A blackmail mark, exposed as a predator

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Todd is the first mark on Erik's blackmail list, and he paid. Erik comes to his door with Jessica to learn whether Todd tried to kill him.
stages.whoA: The blackmailer who targeted him
stages.whoB: Mark number one on his list

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Wendy learns of Jeri's affair with Pam and fights the divorce for 70% of everything. Enthralled by Kilgrave, she tries to kill Jeri with a thousand cuts until Pam strikes her dead.
stages.whoA: Her wife, divorcing her for Pam
stages.whoB: Her wife, killed by Pam

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jeri brings a wounded Kilgrave to Wendy's home, and he orders her to treat him. Before fleeing, he tells her to kill Jeri with a thousand cuts.
stages.whoA: The man who took over her mind
stages.whoB: Jeri's wife, ordered to kill her

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jessica asks Wendy for Sufentanil and gets an anti-psychotic prescription instead. Later, for Jeri, she dangles Wendy over the subway tracks to make her sign the divorce papers.
stages.whoA: Jeri's P.I., who threatened her
stages.whoB: Jeri's wife, a doctor

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Whizzer begs Jessica to protect him from something hunting him, and she brushes him off. When he pulls a gun and flees at super speed, she chases him and finds him dead under scaffolding.
stages.whoA: The P.I. he begged for protection
stages.whoB: A speedster who begged for her help

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Something strong and fast hunts Whizzer through the city. Alisa catches up with him and brings scaffolding down on him.
stages.whoA: The killer who hunted him
stages.whoB: A speedster she killed

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Zaya and Malcolm date and work together at Hogarth & Associates. She edits the footage of him letting the masked vigilante go, but he pulls away, and she leaves when she finds Brianna at his place.
stages.whoA: Her boyfriend and fellow associate
stages.whoB: His girlfriend, a lawyer at Jeri's firm

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Zaya works under Jeri and calls her the best mentor. Jeri sets her on the masked vigilante's trail, and Zaya edits the security footage to hide Malcolm's part.
stages.whoA: Her boss and mentor
stages.whoB: A lawyer at her firm

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev livestreams Shaun's fight against the men who attack him on a San Francisco bus. He cheers Shaun on and grades the fight for his viewers as it goes.
stages.whoA: The bus passenger whose fight he livestreams
stages.whoB: The vlogger who livestreams his bus fight

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev and Katy are on the bus when Shaun is attacked. With the driver knocked out, Klev refuses to drive, and Katy takes the wheel.
stages.whoA: The passenger who drives the bus he will not
stages.whoB: The vlogger who refuses to drive the bus

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Klev cheers for Shaun until a man with a blade for an arm joins the attack on the bus, then takes it back. The attacker slices the bus apart as Klev keeps filming.
stages.whoA: The bladed attacker who wrecks his bus
stages.whoB: A vlogger filming on the bus he wrecks

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo and Katy are old friends who once went joyriding in a stolen Mustang. Over dinner Soo urges Katy to use her Berkeley degree, then watches Wong lead Katy away through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend, a valet with a Berkeley degree
stages.whoB: Her old friend, now a lawyer

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Soo tells Shaun he is wasting his talents parking cars. Two weeks later she mocks his story of saving the world, until Wong calls for Shang-Chi and takes him through a portal.
stages.whoA: Her old friend Shaun, who speaks four languages
stages.whoB: An old friend who says he is wasting his talents

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched blurts out Jen's firing at a family dinner and later barges into her apartment with She-Hulk goods to sign. When Jen says Titania owns the name, he lectures her on trademarks. He also DJs Lulu's wedding and joins the family barbecue.
stages.whoA: His cousin Jen, a lawyer who is also She-Hulk
stages.whoB: Her cousin, a Best Buy manager

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched excitedly greets Bruce when he turns up at the family barbecue, back from Sakaar. When Bruce introduces his son Skaar, Ched asks about the space thing.
stages.whoA: His cousin Bruce, back from Sakaar
stages.whoB: A cousin at the family barbecue

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to bring up Jen's firing, but Ched blurts it out, saying he thought Morris wanted it mentioned. Both are at the family barbecue too.
stages.whoA: Jen's dad, who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca yells at Ched when he blurts out Jen's firing at the family dinner. Both later sit down to the family barbecue with Matt Murdock.
stages.whoA: A relative who scolds him at dinner
stages.whoB: A relative who blurts out Jen's firing

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Ched DJs Lulu's wedding as DJ In-ch-ch-chedible Hulk, hyping her guests at the reception.
stages.whoA: The bride whose wedding he DJs
stages.whoB: The DJ at her wedding

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck calls Jen on a Sunday after Blonsky's inhibitor sends a malfunction alert and asks her to meet him at the retreat as backup. He urges her to hulk out, then leaves once the device is fixed.
stages.whoA: Blonsky's lawyer, his backup at the retreat
stages.whoB: Blonsky's parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Chuck checks on Blonsky at his retreat after an inhibitor alert, fearing he will find the Abomination. Blonsky blames a jolt from an electric fence, and Chuck recalibrates the inhibitor.
stages.whoA: The parolee he supervises
stages.whoB: His parole officer

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius echoes Donny's every word when Wong and Jen serve a cease and desist, and backs him in court. When Donny's act lets demons loose, Donny apologizes to him, and Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: The magician he hype-mans
stages.whoB: His hype man at the Mystic Castle

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Cornelius sides with Donny against Wong's cease and desist and in court. When demons overrun the magic show, Wong and Jen fight them off and Cornelius gives in.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer suing Donny
stages.whoB: Donny's hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen asks Cornelius if he is just hype-manning Donny when he echoes him. During the demon attack she holds a demon over the pair until Cornelius agrees to the cease and desist.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer, who serves the cease and desist
stages.whoB: Donny's echoing hype man

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Dennis tries to take over Jen's closing at the DA's office and needles She-Hulk at the bar. When he sues the woman who posed as Megan Thee Stallion, Jen testifies he is deluded enough to believe it, and he wins. Later he tells television that he dated her and she was psycho.
stages.whoA: A former coworker who testifies he is deluded
stages.whoB: A smug former coworker at the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Bukowski brings his suit against the shapeshifter who posed as Megan Thee Stallion to GLK&H and picks Pug as his lawyer. Pug calls Jen as a witness and wins him $175,000.
stages.whoA: His lawyer at GLK&H
stages.whoB: A client from the DA's office

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Runa posed as Megan Thee Stallion and took Bukowski for $175,000 before revealing herself. He sues her, and she loses and is jailed for impersonating a judge.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who scammed him
stages.whoB: The mark she scammed as Megan Thee Stallion

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki jokes that she will kill Dennis when he tries to take Jen's closing, and later tells him to take a lap at the bar. She calls him gross before Jen testifies in his case.
stages.whoA: A paralegal who cannot stand him
stages.whoB: A coworker she cannot stand

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Wong sues Donny for using the Mystic Arts in his shows after he was kicked out of Kamar-Taj. Donny mocks him and wins a ruling to keep performing. When demons pour through, Donny begs Wong for help and agrees to stop.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer who sues him
stages.whoB: A Kamar-Taj dropout misusing magic

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen serves Donny with Wong's cease and desist, and he mocks her dating app. During the demon attack she holds a demon over him until he agrees to sign.
stages.whoA: Wong's lawyer
stages.whoB: The magician she serves with papers

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Donny sends Madisynn through a portal during his show into a realm full of demons. She later testifies about it in Wong's case against him.
stages.whoA: A volunteer he sent through a portal
stages.whoB: The magician who sent her through a portal

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh charms Jen at Lulu's wedding and they share fries after her fight with Titania. After a few dates he draws her blood as she sleeps, copies her phone and ghosts her. A recording of their night is later shown at her awards gala.
stages.whoA: The woman he seduced to steal her blood
stages.whoB: A charming date who ghosts her

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: After taking Jen's blood, Josh texts HulkKing that the job is done. Todd later admits he hired Josh to seduce Jen and steal her blood.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, who hired him
stages.whoB: The man he hired to seduce Jen

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Josh is a guest of the groom at Lulu's wedding. Lulu pulls Jen away from him to help her clean up inside.
stages.whoA: The bride at the wedding he attends
stages.whoB: A guest of the groom

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen breaks out of her show and confronts K.E.V.I.N., who says he makes every decision. She argues her ending is a mess, and he agrees to her changes. He then locks her out and jokes about seeing her on the big screen.
stages.whoA: The hero who rewrites his ending
stages.whoB: The AI who makes the decisions

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Lulu, Jen's old high school friend, makes her a bridesmaid and makes her promise not to be She-Hulk at the wedding. She dismisses Jen's fears about Titania and puts her to work. After the fight, a tipsy Lulu hugs She-Hulk.
stages.whoA: Her high school friend and bridesmaid
stages.whoB: Her high school friend, the bride

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Titania turns up at Lulu's wedding as a guest. Lulu welcomes her and tells Jen she sounds insane for thinking Titania came to cause trouble.
stages.whoA: A celebrity guest at her wedding
stages.whoB: The bride at the wedding she crashes

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At a family dinner, Melanie offers to give Jen chunky highlights like She-Hulk's hair. At the barbecue she sits by Jen and Matt.
stages.whoA: Jen, whose hair she offers to restyle
stages.whoB: A stylist at the family dinners

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the Walters family barbecue, Melanie eyes Matt and asks why he does not stay longer. She is pulled away to help with the hamburgers.
stages.whoA: Jen's date at the barbecue
stages.whoB: A guest who flirts with him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price rejects Runa's claim of diplomatic immunity, saying Thor's speeches are not admissible. After Runa poses as him to drop the case, he jails her for 60 days.
stages.whoA: The shapeshifter who impersonates him
stages.whoB: The judge she impersonates

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Price presides as Jen gives her closing when Titania crashes in. He rules on Bukowski's case after her testimony, and later sides with Matt against her in the Patilio suit.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who appears in his court
stages.whoB: A judge who hears her cases

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Matt arrives late to Price's court to defend Luke Jacobson. Price agrees the client list stays private, and dismisses the case once Matt shows the plaintiff used jet fuel.
stages.whoA: A lawyer who wins in his court
stages.whoB: The judge who rules his way

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Rebecca is at the family dinner after Jen is fired and scolds Ched for bringing it up. At the barbecue Jen tells her not to ask Matt how much money he makes.
stages.whoA: Her niece Jen
stages.whoB: Her Aunt Rebecca

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: At the barbecue, Rebecca quizzes Matt about his Hell's Kitchen practice. When he says he takes cases that do not pay, she concludes he does not make much money.
stages.whoA: Jen's date, a Hell's Kitchen lawyer
stages.whoB: Jen's aunt, who grills him

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Morris tells the family not to mention Jen's firing before Ched blurts it out. At the barbecue he points out to Rebecca that Matt has his own practice.
stages.whoA: A relative who hosts the family meals
stages.whoB: A relative at the family meals

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Jen testifies in Bukowski's suit that he is deluded enough to have believed Runa was Megan Thee Stallion. Her testimony wins the case, and Runa is jailed.
stages.whoA: The witness who sinks her case
stages.whoB: The scammer in Bukowski's case

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Pug represents Bukowski in his suit against Runa and sees through her when she poses as the judge. He wins full damages for his client.
stages.whoA: The lawyer suing her
stages.whoB: The defendant he beats in court

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball and his crew jump Jen with stolen Asgardian tools, and he tries to take her blood with a needle. It bends on her skin, and the crew flees.
stages.whoA: The Hulk whose blood he fails to take
stages.whoB: A thug who tries to take her blood

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Thunderball fails to get She-Hulk's blood, and his crew leader says their boss is going to be mad. He later sits at the Intelligencia gathering where Todd turns out to be its founder, HulkKing.
stages.whoA: HulkKing, the head of Intelligencia
stages.whoB: A member at his Intelligencia gathering
